reviews.text: Jean has been coloring and cutting my hair for 16 years! She has always done an excellent job! Beautiful salon and the nicest people, would never go anywhere else!
Stephanie is amazing!! So friendly and down to earth, listens to what I want and offers very helpful suggestions! I finally found an amazing hair dresser!!

You know you found a GREAT hair salon with Lauren! She is amazing. When you get a wash, style and consultation in less than one hour, this stylist knows her trade!! I am so happy I found her and have been very pleased each time.
